reason: Release-please PRs: the dispatch-gate design proved ineffective (workflow_dispatch check runs never enter the PR statusCheckRollup) while real per-PR workflows DO fire and evidence-gate/review legitimately fail on a version/changelog-only diff. Fix: release-fast-pass skip `if:` on each gating job (skipped required checks satisfy the ruleset), release-please.yml verifies the diff allowlist then close/reopens + arms auto-merge, gate workflow deleted. Ships as operator patch REL-03 (workflows are constitution-guarded).
